name: Claude 3
description: Feed-first Claude Code session supervisor — routes permissions and session history to iPhone

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Launch a new Claude Code session in a repository, or show the repo picker when no path is given.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Send a message to a live Claude Code session.

tools.name: stop_session
tools.description: Interrupt a live Claude Code session.

tools.name: migrate_to_tmux
tools.description: Move a terminal-observed session into a tmux window for full bidirectional control.
